plugins.name: iot-builder
plugins.description: Measurement-first IoT and embedded project builder with board, toolchain, workflow, and electrical-safety references.

interface.shortDescription: Build, flash, and debug embedded hardware safely.
interface.longDescription: Measurement-first hardware identification, toolchain selection, build/flash/monitor workflows, and electrical-safety references for microcontrollers and Linux SBCs.
defaultPrompt: Identify this board from measurements and build a safe firmware workflow.

plugins.name: ledger-wallet-cli
plugins.description: Optional Wallet CLI Harness integration backed by the official wallet-cli 1.0.2 JSON contract and a local stdio MCP adapter.

interface.shortDescription: Use Ledger hardware wallets through the official wallet-cli.
interface.longDescription: Adds the Wallet CLI Harness scripts, strict flag validation, NDJSON result parsing, and an MCP adapter for Ledger's official wallet-cli without embedding Ledger-specific commands or UI in AgenC core.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my Ledger Wallet CLI session safely.

plugins.name: zeroday-hunter
plugins.description: Exploit-first vulnerability research campaigns with quantitative gates, deterministic proof, independent falsification, and hashed evidence.

interface.longDescription: Campaign-oriented source-code security research with bounded slices, quantitative gates, deterministic PoC verification, independent falsification, and variant sweeps.
defaultPrompt: Run an authorized vulnerability research campaign against this repository.
